name: Optum customer care floor (unofficial)
source: Observed from the public site optum.com on 2026-11-16: computed colours and font names, and the look of the home page. This is not the company's brand guide.
use: Internal posters and floor-screen slides for a customer care team. The organisation's own brand guide, templates and logo files always win over this file.

ground.role: Warm white. The default background of every sheet.

ink.role: Charcoal. All text and line drawings. Never pure black.

accent.role: Orange. One large shape per sheet, or the single thing to act on. Not for small text on the warm white: it does not reach 3:1.
accent.note: Approximate value for the brand orange; confirm against the brand guide.

tint.role: Pale sky blue. A quiet band or panel for secondary information.

link.role: Deep teal blue. Small labels, numbers and links where orange would fail contrast.

colour_rules: One orange element per sheet. If two things are orange, neither is the signal.
Text is charcoal on warm white or white, or white on charcoal.
No gradients, no glow, no drop shadows.

display.use: Headlines. Sentence case, tight leading, slightly negative tracking.

emphasis.use: One word or phrase in a headline, in the same charcoal as the rest. Once per sheet.

type_rules: If the brand fonts are installed on the machine, use them and drop the stand-ins.
Sentence case. No all-capitals headlines. Capitals only for one small tracked label.
Headlines speak plainly, as a person would: short, active, no slogans.

shape.signature: A thick orange ring or disc, large, cropped by the edge of the sheet so it is never seen whole. People or the subject sit inside or in front of it.
shape.controls: Pill-shaped buttons and tags (fully rounded ends).
shape.drawing: Simple charcoal line or solid drawings with round ends. No clip art, no emoji.
shape.photography: Real people, candid and warm, cut out against the ring or on plain ground. Use only photographs supplied by the team with permission. Never generated people.

layout.space: Generous. At least a third of the sheet is empty warm white.
layout.alignment: Flush left. The ring sits right and bleeds off the edge.

tone_rules: Speak to a colleague, not at a workforce. Encourage, never scold.
One habit, one event or one reminder per sheet.
Recognition names the person and what they did, in their words where possible.
hard_rules: No member, patient or caller information of any kind: no names, IDs, dates of birth, call details, screenshots of systems. When in doubt, leave it out and ask.
No performance numbers, targets, rankings or quotes unless they are in the brief.
Do not redraw or approximate the logo. Place the official logo file if it is supplied, following its clear-space rules; otherwise leave the logo off.
Nothing that could be mistaken for an official company statement to the public. These sheets are for the team.
Health or benefits claims are never written by the designer. They come from approved copy only.
Contrast of 4.5:1 for all reading text, and images of people that reflect the team.
typical_briefs: A call-quality habit for the week
